name: CVE-2023-24612
description: The PdfBook extension through 2.0.5 before b07b6a64 for MediaWiki allows command injection via an option. CVE project by @Sn0wAlice

name: CVE-2023-22324
description: SQL injection vulnerability in the CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) Ver.3.5.0 and earlier allows a remote authenticated attacker to execute an arbitrary SQL command. As a result, information stored in the database may be obtained. CVE project by @Sn0wAlice

name: CVE-2022-42484
description: An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the httpd logs/view.cgi functionality of FreshTomato 2022.5. A specially crafted HTTP request can lead to arbitrary command execution. An attacker can send an HTTP request to trigger this vulnerability. CVE project by @Sn0wAlice

name: CVE-2019-4364
description: IBM Maximo Asset Management 7.6 is vulnerable to CSV injection, which could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbirary commands on the system. IBM X-Force ID: 161680. CVE project by @Sn0wAlice

name: CVE-2018-3746
description: The pdfinfojs NPM module versions <= 0.3.6 has a command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the victim's machine. CVE project by @Sn0wAlice

name: CVE-2019-11821
description: SQL injection vulnerability in synophoto_csPhotoDB.php in Synology Photo Station before 6.8.11-3489 and before 6.3-2977 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL command via the type parameter. CVE project by @Sn0wAlice
